about: Human check of the RunPod SDG matches (data/derived/sdg-skill-matches.json). The app shows a skill-to-target match only if its similarity is at least the threshold and it is not rejected here. Rejected matches are counted on screen.
thresholdReason: Spot-check 21 Oct 2026 (data/derived/sdg-spotcheck.md): below 0.60 most best matches were unrelated (e.g. 'use office systems' -> 12.6); at 0.60 and above most were fair.
reviewedBy: Drafted by Claude on 21 Oct 2026 from the 73 matches at or above 0.60; to be confirmed by the team before submission.

rejectTargets.reason: About food production and agriculture; none of the nine roles works in farming.
About water quality; matched on the words 'waste' and 'efficiency', not on water work.
About water-use efficiency; matched on 'efficiency', not on water work.
About equal opportunity and discrimination; matched on 'policy' and 'legislation' wording only.
About migration of people; 'automated migration methods' moves data, not people.
About marine and coastal ecosystems; none of the matched skills is about the sea.
About the debt of developing countries; matched on the word 'sustainability'.
About the global partnership between countries; matched on the word 'sustainable' in many skills, not on partnership work.

rejectPairs.reason: 16.10 is about public access to information; confidentiality is the opposite direction.
